finding: The local trend and fingerprint-bound synthetic-kernel gate validate sample totals, task-by-repeat planning, reported success ratio, per-task failure counts and SHA-256 fingerprint syntax. Optional intervention, usage and billed-cost limits fail closed on unknown values. A configurable minimum number of comparable summaries fails the gate when runs are missing. The 11-case verifier and frozen AZ-004 synthetic summary pass; independence of future runs is not established by the count alone.
conclusion_proposal: Keep pending until the lifecycle harness and repeated actual target-scope measurements support a quality decision.
next_action: Wire the gate to the stable lifecycle harness, collect repeated actual desktop/model summaries, then perform unified review.
